brief:
Hamas rejected accusations from UN Middle East envoy Nickolay Mladenov over halted commercial deliveries to Gaza, claiming he sided with Israel by repeating its version of events, Middle East Eye reported. The Palestinian faction disputed Mladenov's framing of the dispute over goods entering the strip.

The disagreement centers on which party bears responsibility for the suspension of commercial shipments. Hamas's rejection signals friction between the organization and international mediators involved in Gaza affairs.
dek: Hamas accuses Mladenov of siding with Israel over Gaza goods dispute Hamas has rejected accusations from Board of Peace Director-General Nickolay Mladenov over halted commercial deliveries to Gaza, saying he repeated Israel’s account.
title: Hamas rejects Mladenov's account of Gaza goods dispute
